output.summary: FY2026 records are mostly a commodity price rally: revenue rose 46.5% while bushels fell 0.9%, and the cooperative ranked below the peer median on net savings growth. The cost-per-bushel gain comes entirely from maintenance cut 33%, while the deferred work-order backlog tripled and the insurer found critical Harlan Junction dust and monitoring hazards. The ignition-source near-miss was closed without the investigation SP-04 requires. Drying and grading knowledge sits with one person near retirement and has no documentation or successor. The expansion case assumes FY2026 prices and unsourced throughput growth, and the staffing and maintenance plans are missing. Correct the hazards first, start succession, and defer the vote until the financial case is rebuilt.
